intro: Every iCARE dog is rescued from a difficult start, cared for with patience, and matched carefully with a family abroad. Here's the journey — and how you can be part of it.

steps.title: Meet a dog
steps.body: Browse our dogs and open the profile of any who catches your heart.

steps.title: Apply
steps.body: Fill in the application on that dog's page. We read every one personally.

steps.title: We talk it through
steps.body: We discuss your home and the right match. We've placed hundreds of dogs in happy homes — and we're glad to put you in touch with an adopter near you, so you can hear what it's really like first-hand.

steps.title: The journey
steps.body: Your dog travels to your country. Sometimes they arrive ahead of time and stay with one of our intermediate host families until you're ready to welcome them.

steps.title: Welcome home
steps.body: Your new family member arrives — and a lifetime together begins.

blocks.title: Families across the world will vouch for us 💙
blocks.body: We've sent rescue dogs to families in Germany, France, the Netherlands, Belgium, Canada, and the US. If you'd like reassurance from someone who's already been through it, just let us know during the process — we're happy to connect you with an adopter in your area who can share their honest, first-hand experience.

blocks.title: We make no profit
blocks.body: Adoption fees vary by destination, but iCARE makes no profit. Our volunteers give their time for free, so the fee mainly covers the dog's flight and travel paperwork. Every penny goes toward getting dogs safely to their new families.

blocks.title: ✈️ We always need flight volunteers
blocks.body: Many of our dogs reach their new homes thanks to ordinary travellers. If you're already flying to one of our destination countries, you can help a dog travel as accompanied luggage — it costs you nothing extra and saves a rescue hundreds. No experience needed: we handle the crate, the paperwork, and the airport hand-over. Got a trip coming up? We'd love to hear from you.
